module: "General" section of the Mission Editor: edits the mission's name and description (ImGui text fields) and displays a translation icon (green if _tr finds a translation, red otherwise, with the translation in the tooltip). The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/missionEditor/general')(missionEditor). Any modification sets mission._dirty = true.
notes: The description can be a string or a table; a table is not editable (it is displayed with dumps).
Minor bug: getMissionIssues compares the translation with the name without testing the name's type; only the description case explicitly handles a table.

C.desc: General section sub-window, created by the constructor returned by the module.

init.desc: Constructor: remembers the reference to the missionEditor and prepares the recommended fields (recommended attributes of gameplay_missions_missions).

setMission.desc: Selects the mission to edit: creates the name and description buffers and clears the cached translations.

getMissionIssues.desc: Calls setMission then returns the issues: missing name (error), missing description (error), name without translation (warning), description without translation (warning).

draw.desc: Draws the Name and Description fields and their translation icons; saves the modifications into the mission at the end of the edit.
